subject: world_language
concept: Giving reasons and explanations for opinions and plans, connecting ideas with 'because' and 'so'
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B1 'give reasons and explanations' can-do descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student states an opinion and then a reason, connecting them aloud with the target-language word for 'because'
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an opinion to its logical supporting reason
exercise.abstract: Student writes a sentence connecting an opinion to a reason using appropriate connecting words

misconception_flags: states an opinion and a reason as two unconnected sentences rather than linking them

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
